comment: Voiceover script for the marketing video, written to flow like natural speech (connected sentences, contractions) rather than ad-copy fragments. Order defines scene order. `clip` names the recorded footage (from record.mjs), `min`/`max` bound the scene length in seconds; the assembler stretches each scene to fit its narration. Optional `say` is the text actually sent to the TTS: pronunciation respellings ('Neuroster' phonemizes badly; 'Nurrohster' renders the intended nur-OH-ster) and dashes flattened to commas; `vo` stays the human-readable line.

scenes.vo: This is Neuroster — a world-building colony game where all of your workers happen to be hamsters.
scenes.say: This is Nurrohster, a world-building colony game where all of your workers, happen to be hamsters.

scenes.vo: You start by founding a colony in a living world. Pick a biome you like, and your first few hamsters get right to work — digging, hauling, and settling in.
scenes.say: You start by founding a colony in a living world. Pick a biome you like, and your first few hamsters get right to work, digging, hauling, and settling in.

scenes.vo: Then you build, you automate, and you thrive.
You'll mine materials and refine them, then grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops — and once the toil is automated, the whole colony really comes alive.
scenes.say: You'll mine materials and refine them, then grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops. And once the toil is automated, the whole colony really comes alive.

scenes.vo: And every rodent here is a somebody — they've got names, families, and jobs to do, and it's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.
scenes.say: And every rodent here is a somebody. They've got names, families, and jobs to do, and it's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.

scenes.vo: But out here, the wild is always watching.
Predators, disasters, rival factions — so you'll raise a garrison, research new skills, and evolve your rodents to handle whatever comes.
scenes.say: Predators, disasters, rival factions. So you'll raise a garrison, research new skills, and evolve your rodents to handle whatever comes.

scenes.vo: Neuroster. It's your colony, and your world — so grab a shovel, and start digging.
scenes.say: Nurrohster. It's your colony, and your world. So grab a shovel, and start digging.
